user_reported_bug: Point 26: If any customer is getting registered from RWA QR code then issue coupon to such NEW customer only if coupon code exists in backend; admin must upload coupon codes with Brand Name, Coupon Code, Coupon Value, Expiry Date, track issued coupons and remaining inventory; same for other registration QR sources.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused backend/API + preview UI verification completed for Registration Coupon Inventory. Core coupon upload, dry-run non-persistence, duplicate skip, inventory/issued endpoints, atomic N+1 issuance, WhatsApp RWA new-registration coupon message, existing-user no-extra-issue, and admin UI /coupons flow all worked. However, POST /api/admin/coupons/bulk-upload accepts an invalid Expiry Date ('not-a-date') as an available coupon instead of counting it as invalid, so the upload validation requirement is only partially fixed.

critical.issue: Rows with invalid Expiry Date are imported with status='available' (e.g. expiry='not-a-date') instead of being rejected/counted in summary.invalid. This can lead to invalid coupons being issued to new QR registrations.

action_items: Validate Expiry Date during CSV upload (YYYY-MM-DD parse at minimum; ideally reject past dates or mark expired per product rule) and include invalid date rows in summary.invalid without persisting them.
Add a backend regression test covering invalid/missing expiry values for coupon bulk upload.
Retest /api/admin/coupons/bulk-upload, inventory counts, and the /coupons UI upload summary after the validation fix.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/coupons.py validates brand, code, and numeric value, but stores expiry as an unchecked string; issue_coupon_for_registration can later issue that invalid-date coupon because it only filters source_code + status='available'.

Runtime startup had no coupon-route 500s; backend log warnings/errors seen were pre-existing index warnings and test-induced TagnPay errors from an initial malformed test phone. A follow-up valid 91+10-digit webhook registration was run and coupon issuance/message logging passed.

success_rate.backend: 92% (all core issuance/inventory/WhatsApp paths passed; invalid expiry upload validation failed)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST41_* coupon rows, two webhook test users/logs, and a temporary UI CSV during testing; cleanup verified 0 remaining TEST41 coupon codes/users/WhatsApp logs in MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Newest verification report is iteration_41/bug_verification_41. Re-test invalid Expiry Date handling first. Confirm dry-run still does not persist, live upload invalid count increments, inventory totals exclude invalid rows, and a valid RWA webhook still issues a coupon and appends 'Welcome Coupon Unlocked' with brand/code/value. No relevant testing skill was available for this bug.
rca_of_the_issue: Reproduction: login as admin, POST multipart CSV to /api/admin/coupons/bulk-upload with source_code=SRC_RWA and a row like Brand=Any, Code=Any, Coupon Value=100, Expiry Date=not-a-date. Actual: API returns success with imported count incremented and MongoDB stores the row as status='available'. Expected: row should be rejected/counted invalid and not persist, because Expiry Date is a required upload field and invalid rows must be counted in invalid.
